annotations.text: DAILY LOOP  —  open → Dashboard → Today (max 3 cards, missed blocks reschedule calmly) → Study Now (time-boxed pick) → run & log the session in under 2 minutes
SUBJECTS & READINESS  —  subject list → chapters with state + school status → chapter readiness split into concept / practice / test / recall / revision, with data provenance
REVISION & ASSESSMENT  —  spaced-retrieval queue with a calm recovery plan · add a school test in <30s (plan recalculates) · enter result & tag where marks were lost
REVIEW, PLAN & MORE  —  weekly review (now with study-rhythm adherence) · date-driven plan setup with a live phase preview · aggregate parent view (later phase) · More menu

DISCIPLINE & COURSE CORRECTION  —  study windows + reminders + calendar sync + adherence · impact on goal: readiness projection vs target with plan-pressure drivers · course-correction sheet where you accept/decline the trade-offs (capacity is never raised silently)

All figures come from fixtures/synthetic-academic-data.json — illustrative derived weights, not official CBSE chapter marks. Context date = 2 Sep 2026, so the plan sits in the Syllabus-coverage phase.

Direction: focused high-contrast. Near-black ink on warm paper, Space Grotesk headings + IBM Plex Sans/Mono, one electric-blue accent reserved for the single next action. No gamification, calm language, mobile-first at 390px.
